sections.title: Endpoint evidence
sections.sql: select e.code,e.name,h.health,h.checked_at,h.evidence from renewal_targets t join endpoints e on e.id=t.endpoint_id join endpoint_health h on h.id=e.id where t.renewal_id=$1

sections.title: Certificate bindings
sections.sql: select h.code,h.common_name,h.not_after,h.health,h.checked_at from endpoint_health h join endpoints e on e.id=h.id where e.service_id=$1
